question: A man travels some distance at a speed of 12 km/h and returns at a speed of 8 km/h. If the total time taken by him is 3 hours and 45 minutes, then the total distance (in km) travelled is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Average Speed = (2 × S₁ × S₂) ÷ (S₁ + S₂)

Average Speed = (2 × 12 × 8) ÷ (12 + 8) = 192 ÷ 20 = 9.6 km/h

Total Time = 3 hr 45 min = 3 + (45 ÷ 60) = 15 ÷ 4 hr

Total Distance = Average Speed × Total Time

Total Distance = 9.6 × (15 ÷ 4) = 36 km

**∴ The correct answer is 36 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 
 
• 
 Speed = 12 km/h (Forward)
 
• 
 Speed = 8 km/h (Return)
 Distance = d km
 Total Time = 3 hr 45 min
 
• 
 
• 

**Given:**

Forward Speed (S₁) = 12 km/h

Return Speed (S₂) = 8 km/h

Total Time (T) = 3 hr 45 min = 3 + 3/4 = 15 ÷ 4 hr

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculation:**

Let the one-way distance be d km.

⇒ Total time = Time taken to travel forward + Time taken to return

⇒ (d ÷ 12) + (d ÷ 8) = 15 ÷ 4

⇒ (2d + 3d) ÷ 24 = 15 ÷ 4

⇒ 5d ÷ 24 = 15 ÷ 4

⇒ 5d = (15 × 24) ÷ 4

⇒ 5d = 90

⇒ d = 18 km

⇒ Total distance travelled = 2 × d

⇒ Total distance = 2 × 18 = 36 km

**∴ The correct answer is 36 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed (Equal Distances)

When equal distances are covered at speeds x and y, Average Speed = (2 × x × y) ÷ (x + y).

Average Speed (General Formula)

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time.

Distance when Time Difference is given

Distance = (S₁ × S₂) ÷ (S₁ − S₂) × ΔT (where ΔT is difference in time).
